label: preparing
what: A secret surprise jubilee celebrating the mayor's forty years of service, scheduled for day 1 at 18:00 in the great hall. Innkeeper, freight and builder organized it, preparing 201 fresh loaves and eight lanterns. Neighbour knowingly baked and delivered bread and promised secrecy; baker knowingly supplied oven access and bartered wheat; secretary learned the celebration's purpose privately on day 1 at 06:38 and then confirmed escorting the mayor precisely at 18:00 without disclosing that purpose. Mayor was told about bread, the committee and a meeting, but the record does not show him being told the jubilee's purpose before the record ends.
